Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoList
Description: AutoList turns retainer Market Board chores into supervised AutoList, AutoRefresh, and AutoTidy workflows with a small in-game tray that lights up when your character is ready to start.
Punchline: Turn retainer listing from market-board chore into one-click momentum.
Changelog:
Fixed AutoList repeated-stack pricing so brief empty market comparison reads do not cause later stacks of the same item and quality to fall back to the Free Market Price.
AutoList now reuses the most recent real competitor price for that item during the current session and logs when this safeguard is used.
